QuestInfo.name: The Third Training Session
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Father to begin the next training session.
QuestInfo.1:
Your third task is to retrieve #bWhite Sparrow Egg#k #rx15#k. You can get #bWhite Sparrow Eggs#k from the #bGlutinous Rice Sparrows#k in the #bRemote Forest Clearing#k.
Be careful not to venture off to the Wildland -- that's the Stray Dogs' territory.

0.msg: Go defeat the #bGlutinous Rice Sparrows#k of the #bRemote Forest Clearing#k, and bring back #bWhite Sparrow Egg#k #rx15#k.\r\n
